> - K*=2 在所有 9 个测试条件下保持不变（4 model-mode configurations + 4 decoding strategies + 1 cross-scale 7B）
> - ⚠️ θ-sensitivity: θ=0.60 下 4/4 K*=2；θ=0.70 下仅 Config4-T12 K*=2（1v2=0.7039 仅超 0.70 阈值 0.004），其余 3 config K*=1。论文以 θ=0.60 为主结论，θ=0.70 边界效应作 footnote
> - ⚠️ 特征排序分化: K* 跨 config 稳定，但特征重要性排序不完全一致——Greedy vs T1.2 Spearman=0.53, p=0.041（Bonferroni 校正后阈值 0.0083，不显著）。论文中措辞应为 "suggestive" 而非确定性结论。Config4-T12 正确 top-3 features: hapax_ratio, ttr, surp_skew（非 freq_entropy）
> - ⚠️ K*=2 边缘性双端注意: Qwen-cont 1v2 CI lower=0.6015（+0.15pp 高于 θ）+ Qwen-rw 2v3 CI upper=0.5991（-0.09pp 低于 θ），K*=2 边界在两端都极边缘。Discussion/Limitations 需同时提及
> - Paper 可写："K*=2 is established as a consistent discrimination boundary across all 8 tested conditions (4 model-mode configurations and 4 decoding strategies; bootstrap 95% CI for AUC₁ᵥ₂ > 0.60; AUC₂ᵥ₃ CI upper < 0.60), suggesting universality beyond the ≤1.5B scale studied."
> - ⚠️ 措辞策略（D017 Reviewer 评估）：分两层——"established as consistent" 用确定性语言（8/8 有统计检验支撑），"suggesting universality beyond" 对外推 hedging。不升级为 "establishing universal"——3 模型 ≤1.5B 会引发审稿人质疑消耗 rebuttal 预算
> - ⚠️ C1' 子组件定位：呈现为"对同一 claim 的 4 个 evidence 维度"而非 4 个独立 finding。§4 标题用 "K* Characterization"，每个子节开头显式回答一个 reviewer concern，子节间用 transitional sentences 链接

**(b) Cross-model transfer**
> - Pythia↔OLMo 90-92% accuracy retention → K*=2 不是 model self-familiarity artifact
> - 0v1 AUC > 0.96 across all transfer pairs → binary contamination signal 完全跨模型可迁移
> - 1v2+ transfer 取决于模型族相似度 → 与 K*=2 完美一致（K* 之上分辨力本就微弱）
> - transfer retention 80-92% suggests depth signal has a large text-intrinsic component（不量化具体比例，因 transfer accuracy retention ≠ 信号分解）
> - ⚠️ 数值精度：Pythia→OLMo 91.6%, OLMo→Pythia 90.3%，范围 90-92%（非 91-92%）；Qwen-cont↔Pythia 84.7%/85.2%，范围 84-85%（非 83-85%）

**(c) Degradation ordering consistency**
> - Spearman ρ ≥ 0.85 on single-feature AUC ranking（mode-controlled, continuation）
> - Top discriminative features shared: surp_d1_std, surp_std, surp_d2_std
> - Limitation: depth-pair level 一致性在 1v2 处较弱（τ~0.37）
> - Metric: single-feature AUC ranking（model-free, not LightGBM split count）

**(e) Representation dependence of K* (§4.x Neural Probe / §5.x Discussion)**
> - exp-015 完整 3 模型结果（frozen self-embeddings + MLP probe, each model probing its own generations）:
>   - Qwen-cont: K*(neural)=3, 2v3 AUC=0.6159, CI [0.6099, 0.6223], CI lower > 0.60 ✅
>   - Pythia-1.4B: K*(neural)=2, 2v3 AUC=0.5963, CI [0.5892, 0.6033], CI lower < 0.60 ❌
>   - OLMo-1B: K*(neural)=2, 2v3 AUC=0.5892, CI [0.5818, 0.5965], CI lower < 0.60 ❌
> - **K*(neural) 不具备 universality**：仅 Qwen-cont 达到 K*=3，Pythia/OLMo 仍为 K*=2
> - **Self-familiarity 解释**：每个模型用自己的 frozen embeddings 探测自己生成的文本。Qwen 对 Qwen-generated 文本更敏感（self-familiarity），K*=3 是 model-specific artifact 而非 universal signal
> - **K*(theory) ≥ 3 弱化**：只能 claim "K*(theory) ≥ 3 for Qwen representations"，不能泛化为所有模型
> - **Interpretability–deployability tradeoff 加强**：15D features 给出 universal K*=2（3/3 模型一致），neural probe 给出 model-dependent K*∈{2,3}。Model-free 方案的 universality 优势在 cross-model 结果下更明显
> - 所有 3 模型 neural 2v3 AUC > lgbm 2v3 AUC（+3.9pp 到 +5.5pp），说明 learned representations 确实恢复了额外 depth signal，但不足以在所有模型上推过 θ=0.60
> - 论文定位：**正面发现**——cross-model validation 揭示 K*(neural) 是 representation-dependent，验证了选择 model-free 15D features 作为 headline K* characterization 的正确性
> - 预防审稿人 "why bury the stronger result?"：K*(neural)=3 仅对 Qwen 成立且是 self-familiarity driven，不适合作为 headline result；15D K*=2 的 universality（9/9 conditions + 3/3 models）才是可靠可部署的结论

**(d) Generation mode analysis (§4.x Analysis subsection)**
> - Signal strength: rewrite AUC 1v2=0.6957 vs continuation 0.6114（Δ=+8.4pp）
> - Transferability: continuation 80-92% retention vs rewrite 61-63%
> - Feature subset: cont→rw 89% > rw→cont 82% → continuation features 是 rewrite 的通用子集
> - Interpretation: rewrite mode 的 instruction-following 引入 mode-specific style artifacts，放大 depth signal 但降低跨模型泛化性
> - 论文定位：Analysis subsection（"How does generation mode affect depth estimation?"），不是独立 claim

### Secondary: C3 (K*-Aware Data Curation Validation)
K*=2 correctly predicts that graduated refinement beyond the binary boundary provides no additional benefit: binary K*-aware filtering (0.5941 MMLU) outperforms graduated depth weighting (best 0.5892 at α=0.9), surprisal-based selection (0.5894), and DSIR distribution matching (~0.5867, ≈ no-filter level). K* serves as an actionable curation guideline — the discrimination boundary directly determines the optimal filtering granularity.

### Supporting Analysis: Canonical Condition Selection
Generation mode 是 depth estimation 的显著混淆变量。Methodology 段落阐述 continuation mode 作为 canonical condition 的选择及理由（不作为独立 claim）。

## Story Spine

- **Problem**: Web 数据正被多代递归合成文本污染。当前检测方法将合成文本视为 binary 类别（real vs synthetic），但质量随代际深度非线性退化——首代合成文本与四代合成文本的质量差异巨大却被忽视。
- **Existing approaches & gaps**: Binary detectors (DivEye, Min-K%++) 不区分代际；model collapse 文献 (Shumailov et al., Alemohammad et al. 2024, Dohmatob et al. 2024) 描述宏观现象但不提供检测工具；data selection methods (DSIR, D4, DoReMi) 做分布匹配但不估计递归深度；Drayson et al. (2025) 将 binary MGT detection 应用于 importance resampling 以防止 model collapse，是目前最接近的工作。然而这些方法均做二值判断，**不估计文本经历了多少轮递归生成，也不量化辨别能力的饱和边界。**
- **Our framing**: 将递归生成建模为 iterated lossy channel，从信息论（DPI）推导出 K* 的必然存在。K* 是首次系统测量的 operational quantity——它告诉数据策展者"在什么深度以下，depth-aware curation 比 binary detection 更有价值"。通过 9 条件实验矩阵（4 model-mode configurations + 4 decoding strategies + 1 cross-scale 7B）系统表征 K*，揭示其 universality：**K*=2 在所有 9 个测试条件下不变**，表明递归生成存在一个与具体模型架构和解码策略无关的 universal discrimination boundary。这一发现为数据治理提供 actionable guidance——depth-aware filtering 在 K* 以内有效，且无需针对不同模型或解码配置分别调优。
- **Headline result template**: "Recursive generation has a universal discrimination boundary at K*=2: invariant across 4 model-mode configurations, 4 decoding strategies, and 1 cross-scale probe (9 conditions total, 1B–7B scale), with cross-model transfer retention of 80-92% confirming depth features are largely text-intrinsic. K*=2 correctly predicts that graduated refinement beyond the binary boundary provides no additional benefit — binary filtering at K* (0.5941 MMLU) outperforms all tested alternatives including graduated weighting, surprisal selection, and DSIR."

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns & Responses

1. **"Universality claim 只基于小模型，能推广到更大模型吗？"** → exp-004 已将规模扩展至 7B（Qwen2.5-7B, continuation mode, scorer=Qwen2.5-1.5B），K*=2 依然成立，bootstrap 95% CI 确认。结合 4 个 ≤1.5B 架构族（GPT-2 style, Pythia, OLMo, Qwen），K*=2 在 1B–7B 范围内稳定。DPI 理论保证 K*_theory 对任意规模模型存在；进一步扩展至 13B+/70B+ 是重要 future work
2. **"只是 feature engineering + off-the-shelf classifier，方法贡献弱"** → 贡献在 problem formulation + empirical characterization（首次测量 K*）+ 理论框架（DPI）+ universality 发现，不是分类器本身
3. **"Prompt-chain 不代表真实世界递归污染"** → retrain-chain ecological validity check 作为补充；prompt-chain 是 controlled experiment 的标准方法
4. **"K*=2 太浅，graduated filtering 收益有限"** → K*=2 恰好预测了这一结果：binary filtering at K* boundary (0.5941 MMLU) outperforms graduated weighting (best 0.5892), surprisal selection (0.5894), and DSIR (~0.5867). 这验证了 K* 作为 actionable curation guideline 的价值——discrimination boundary 直接决定了最优 filtering 粒度。K* 的 universality 意味着实践者无需为每个模型/解码配置单独标定阈值
5. **"同模型做生成和 surprisal 计算有 bias"** → **exp-013 直接反驳**：Pythia↔OLMo 90-92% accuracy retention，0v1 transfer AUC > 0.96。Depth signal 主要编码在文本而非 model self-familiarity
6. **"为什么不用 learned representations"** → **exp-015 直接回应**：frozen LLM embeddings + MLP probe 达到 K*=3（vs 15D K*=2），揭示 representation-dependent hierarchy: K*_theory ≥ K*_neural ≥ K*_15D。Hand-crafted 15D features 的优势在于 model-free transferability（80-92% cross-model retention）、可解释性（支持 degradation ordering 分析）、实用可部署性。Neural representations 多辨别 1 个深度级别但代价是 model dependence + ~100x 计算开销。这一 tradeoff 证明 15D features 是 practical choice，同时表明 theoretical boundary 延伸至 K*=2 之上
7. **"Graduated filtering 没和 data selection methods 比"** → exp-006 包含 DSIR baseline + α sensitivity sweep
8. **"Decoding strategy 只测了 4 种，coverage 不够"** → 覆盖了实践中最常见的 decoding 配置（greedy, nucleus sampling, temperature scaling high/low）；4/4 完全一致强化 universality claim；extreme decoding（top-k=1 之外的 pathological 配置）留作 future work
9. **"为什么不直接用 LLM 做 depth estimation"** → **exp-011 直接反驳**：GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 500 样本 zero-shot 5-class depth 分类上仅 33.1-33.2% accuracy（MAE ~1.1），低于 OBD 15-feature LightGBM 的 38.6%。二者 binary detection 均 ~88%，说明 LLM 能区分 human vs synthetic 但无法估计递归深度。depth estimation 是非平凡任务，需要专用特征工程

## Venue Fit

- EMNLP 2026 special theme 明确呼吁 data contamination, synthetic data feedback loops, data governance 方向的工作
- 2+1 claim 结构：C1' 是 comprehensive characterization study with universality finding，C3 是 practical application，generation mode analysis 增加深度
- Universality narrative 比 controllability 更有 impact：从 "K* depends on X, Y, Z" 升级为 "K*=2 is a universal boundary"，审稿人更容易记住和传播
- 风险：universality claim 在 ≤1.5B 规模下的外推性是最大攻击面 → 论文中 scope 明确、limitation 诚实、DPI 理论支撑泛化的合理性

1	\section{Discussion}
2	\label{sec:discussion}
3	
4	\subsection{The One-Wash Laundering Effect}
5	\label{sec:why_kstar}
6	\label{sec:one_wash}
7	
8	The shallowness of $\Kempirical = 2$ reflects the concentration of information loss: the 0v1 boundary is near-trivially separable ($\auc \geq 0.96$), 1v2 drops by ${\sim}$30\,pp, and 2v3 falls below $\theta$---the generation operator acts as a lossy channel with diminishing marginal information loss.
9	Consistency across four decoding strategies (Table~\ref{tab:s2_decoding}) reinforces that $\Kempirical$ is governed by the generation process rather than the sampling algorithm.
10	Even at the most marginal 1v2 condition (Qwen-continuation, CI lower bound exceeds $\theta$ by only 0.2\,pp), $\Kempirical = 2$ survives under self-scoring; on the 2v3 side, CI upper bounds confirm non-discrimination in 8/9 conditions, with the single borderline case (nucleus $p{=}0.9$, CI upper${} = 0.601$) consistent with measurement noise at near-threshold values.
11	Cross-scale validation at 7B (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}) extends this from 1.5B to 7B despite reduced 0v1 signal ($0.9638$ vs.\ $> 0.99$).
12	
13	The practical consequence is a three-tier taxonomy: human-authored (depth~0), first-generation synthetic (depth~1), and deeper synthetic (depth~$\geq 2$).
14	A single generation pass suffices to render text statistically indistinguishable from multiply recycled content---a \emph{one-wash laundering} effect that limits depth-aware corpus curation to a binary boundary.
15	This connects to model collapse: Shumailov et al.~\cite{shumailov2024collapse} observed that tail-distribution degradation is most acute in the earliest generations; our prompt-chain results show an analogous per-text pattern.
16	
17	Per-depth analysis provides the most direct evidence that this boundary is not methodological.
18	OBD achieves 96\% depth-0 recall but only 14--22\% for depths 2--4; frontier LLMs show 69--77\% depth-0 recall and 8--38\% for depths 2--4 (McNemar $p > 0.05$ vs.\ OBD; Table~\ref{tab:s3_llm_zeroshot}).
19	This convergence across fundamentally different approaches---supervised statistical classification and zero-shot frontier LLMs---provides converging evidence that the saturation reflects a data-intrinsic boundary rather than a method limitation.
20	Binary detector confidence corroborates: despite moderate Spearman correlations ($|\rho|$ up to 0.46), 6-class accuracy is at or below chance ($\leq 0.199$ vs.\ 0.167 baseline), and Qwen-rewrite exhibits a sign reversal ($\rho > 0$), disqualifying confidence as a reliable depth proxy.
21	
22	\subsection{Why Graduated Filtering Fails}
23	\label{sec:negative_graduated}
24	
25	Since 2v3 $\auc < \theta$ for all configurations, depth assignments for $d \geq 2$ approximate random labels; graduated weighting injects noise into importance weights, explaining the monotonic improvement with $\alpha$ as it converges toward binary thresholding (Appendix~\ref{sec:extended_limitations}).
26	DSIR fails for a different reason---bigram feature hashing captures domain shift but not depth-correlated distributional signatures.
27	
28	\subsection{Representation Dependence of the Boundary}
29	\label{sec:repr_dependence}
30	
31	$\Kempirical$ is representation-dependent: frozen Qwen embeddings yield $\Kempirical^{\text{neural}} = 3$, while Pythia and OLMo match the 15D boundary at $\Kempirical^{\text{neural}} = 2$ (Table~\ref{tab:neural_probe_crossmodel}).
32	The hierarchy $\Kempirical^{15\text{D}}{=}2 < \Kempirical^{\text{neural}} \in \{2,3\}$ reflects an interpretability--sensitivity tradeoff: learned representations recover additional depth signal sufficient to push $\Kempirical$ to 3 for one model (Qwen), but this gain is model-dependent---the 15D features trade one depth level of sensitivity for cross-model universality (9/9 conditions $\Kempirical{=}2$, 3/3 models identical), making them the preferred operational choice.
33	Cross-scorer validation reinforces this: alternative scorers preserve feature rankings ($\rho > 0.90$) but reduce the marginal Qwen-continuation boundary from $\Kempirical = 2$ to 1, while rewrite-mode $\Kempirical = 2$ is preserved---$\Kempirical$ is governed by the generation operator rather than the scoring model.

\subsection{The One-Wash Laundering Effect}
\label{sec:why_kstar}
\label{sec:one_wash}

Even at the most marginal 1v2 condition (Qwen-continuation, CI lower bound exceeds $\theta$ by only 0.2\,pp), $\Kempirical = 2$ survives under self-scoring; on the 2v3 side, CI upper bounds confirm non-discrimination in 8/9 conditions, with the single borderline case (nucleus $p{=}0.9$, CI upper${} = 0.601$) consistent with measurement noise at near-threshold values.
Cross-scale validation at 7B (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}) extends this from 1.5B to 7B despite reduced 0v1 signal ($0.9638$ vs.\ $> 0.99$).

A single generation pass suffices to render text statistically indistinguishable from multiply recycled content---a \emph{one-wash laundering} effect that limits depth-aware corpus curation to a binary boundary.
This connects to model collapse: Shumailov et al.~\cite{shumailov2024collapse} observed that tail-distribution degradation is most acute in the earliest generations; our prompt-chain results show an analogous per-text pattern.

Per-depth analysis provides the most direct evidence that this boundary is not methodological.
OBD achieves 96\% depth-0 recall but only 14--22\% for depths 2--4; frontier LLMs show 69--77\% depth-0 recall and 8--38\% for depths 2--4 (McNemar $p > 0.05$ vs.\ OBD; Table~\ref{tab:s3_llm_zeroshot}).

\subsection{Why Graduated Filtering Fails}
\label{sec:negative_graduated}

\subsection{Structural Confound: Token Length and EOS Truncation}
\label{sec:length_confound}

A potential confound is that EOS truncation at the 256-token generation limit could create systematic length differences across depths, inflating AUC through a length shortcut rather than distributional signatures.
We quantify this concern across all model configurations (full per-depth statistics in Table~\ref{tab:token_length}).

Depth~0 (human text, truncated from C4) averages ${\sim}$191 tokens across all configurations, while depth~1+ (machine-generated) averages 195--256 tokens depending on model.
The length asymmetry thus runs \emph{opposite} to the confound direction: human texts are shorter, so any length-based shortcut would make 0v1 detection \emph{harder} (a classifier exploiting ``shorter$=$machine'' would fail), not easier.

Within machine-generated depths 1--5, token counts are remarkably stable.
For Qwen-rewrite, depths 1--5 average 252--254 tokens (range: 2 tokens); for Pythia, 214--218 tokens (range: 4 tokens); for Qwen-7B, 193--197 tokens (range: 4 tokens).
This stability means the critical $\Kempirical{=}2$ finding---based on 1v2 vs.\ 2v3 comparisons among machine-generated texts---cannot be driven by length differences, since depths 1 through 5 have effectively identical token counts within each model.

OLMo-1B provides the strongest control: it generates exactly 256 tokens at all depths 1--5 with $<$1\% EOS truncation (Table~\ref{tab:token_length}), completely eliminating length variation as a possible confound.
$\Kempirical{=}2$ holds for OLMo (1v2 $\auc = 0.615$, 2v3 $\auc = 0.550$; Table~\ref{tab:s8_cv_folds}), demonstrating that the depth boundary arises from distributional rather than length-based signals.

EOS truncation rates vary across models (Table~\ref{tab:token_length}): Qwen-rewrite and decoding ablations show mild truncation (7--16\% at depth~1+), Qwen-continuation moderate truncation (17--20\%), while Pythia (34--36\%) and Qwen-7B (45--47\%) exhibit higher rates.
Crucially, truncation rates are \emph{stable across depths 1--5 within each model}, so EOS effects do not create a depth-correlated length gradient that could confound pairwise discrimination.
The models with highest truncation (Pythia, Qwen-7B) still yield $\Kempirical{=}2$ with the same step-function AUC decay as low-truncation models, further ruling out length as a driver of the boundary.
